title: Kylie Jenner's birth chart
metaDescription: Kylie Jenner's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 18.2° Leo. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Sun stands at 18.2° Leo, in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: Leo, but precisely: 18.2°, second decan, 10°–20°, under Jupiter in the triplicity scheme. The tradition kept these divisions because thirty degrees is a long street.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 14.2° Virgo; Venus stands at 21.9° Virgo; Mars stands at 27.8° Libra. The tradition reads a mind that trusts the measured and the checked from Mercury, taste for the substantial and the lasting from Venus, drive that argues its way forward from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Start where the chart is tightest — Mars square Neptune, 0.2° of separation. Right angles are where the scheme puts its grit. A square asks two functions to work in a mode neither would have chosen. Behind it, the Sun opposition Jupiter at 1.3°, and the Sun trine Saturn at 2.1° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The classical table has six entries for this chart. The Sun in Leo at 18.2° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; the Moon in Scorpio at 9.7° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Mercury in Virgo at 14.2° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Venus in Virgo at 21.9° is in fall; Mars in Libra at 27.8° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Saturn in Aries at 20.3° is in fall. The old table grades terrain, not talent — a placement in fall works uphill, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Of the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: 3 in fire, 3 in earth, 3 in air, 1 in water by element, 4 fixed, 3 mutable, 3 cardinal by modality. A fire-weighted chart runs hot at the start line — initiative is its native language. Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — motion that reverses only from this vantage point, and which the old reading treats as delay used for revision.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Scorpio for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 12.3° between midnight and midnight. That is quick enough to make the exact degree a neighbourhood rather than an address, and slow enough to leave the sign settled. At the noon reference it stands at 9.7°.
